title: BigQuery Search
blurb: Product impact board for BigQuery Search — vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, AI.SEARCH, VECTOR_SEARCH, and autonomous embeddings search in BigQuery. Built for BQ Search directors and managers tracking GTM. Prefer customer/3P stories; no 1P docs/codelabs; GC Blog only for successful named customer stories.

entries.title: BigQuery Is More Than a Warehouse Now. It’s an AI Runtime
entries.why: Community Medium walks AI.SEARCH hybrid (VECTOR / HYBRID / AUTO) on autonomous embeddings — the clearest public explainer of when AI.SEARCH replaces hand-rolled VECTOR_SEARCH query embedding.

entries.title: How Honeylove boosts product quality and service efficiency with BigQuery
entries.why: Named customer story: Honeylove embeds support tickets with Gemini and runs BigQuery vector search + RAG so agents ask natural-language product questions — ~30s saved per ticket, plus multimodal creative search experiments.

entries.title: BigQuery AI.SEARCH in Practice: When Autonomous Embeddings Beat Your DIY Vector Pipeline on Cost and Ops
entries.why: Independent Medium field guide arguing when autonomous embeddings + AI.SEARCH beat a DIY vector stack on total cost/ops for warehouse-native semantic search and RAG.

entries.title: SQL is all you need: RAG without a vector database in a dozen lines of BigQuery
entries.why: Search-primary RAG recipe: AI.GENERATE_EMBEDDING → VECTOR_SEARCH → AI.GENERATE in a dozen lines, plus the AI.SEARCH shortcut when autonomous embeddings own the lifecycle.

entries.title: BigQuery Vector Search for Support Tickets: A Practical RAG Pipeline That Survives Real Data Mess
entries.why: Practitioner RAG on messy tickets: chunk → embed → VECTOR_SEARCH with metadata filters (product, recency) so semantic retrieval survives PII, threads, and duplicates inside BigQuery SQL.

entries.title: BigQuery Hybrid Search with BM25 + Embeddings: Rerank in SQL for Precision at Low Cost
entries.why: Community hybrid-search playbook: BigQuery search indexes for BM25 keyword recall + VECTOR_SEARCH for semantics, then SQL rerank — the precision/cost framing directors hear when buyers ask “keyword or vector?”

entries.title: Goodbye, Pipelines: Building AI Search in Seconds with BigQuery Autonomous Embeddings
entries.why: Community walkthrough of AI.EMBED generated columns + AI.SEARCH vs VECTOR_SEARCH — the clearest public demo that autonomous embeddings kill DIY embedding pipelines for Search GTM.

entries.title: Using BigQuery ML to solve for the lookalike problem at Zeotap
entries.why: Named CDP customer: Zeotap runs VECTOR_SEARCH over 118M user vectors with TreeAH indexes, rare-feature pre-filters (−78% search space), and batched queries to ship lookalikes in one SQL script — no specialized vector DB.

entries.title: How to Integrate Vector Search in Columnar Storage
entries.why: Deep 3P architecture essay on how BigQuery folds VECTOR_SEARCH into Dremel/Borg/Colossus + TreeAH — the “why warehouse-native vector search” narrative for technical buyers comparing HNSW SaaS vs BQ.

entries.title: Stop Searching, Start Reading: Building a Hybrid Macro-to-Micro RAG Pipeline on BigQuery
entries.why: Hybrid macro-to-micro RAG using VECTOR_SEARCH + CREATE VECTOR INDEX (IVF) for corpus retrieval inside BigQuery — a concrete Search+RAG architecture directors can hand solution engineers.

entries.title: Semantic Search with BigQuery: Keywords to Context
entries.why: End-to-end ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING + VECTOR_SEARCH used-cars demo — practical semantic-search collateral for Search GTM without a separate vector DB.

entries.why: Ops-focused community guide to VECTOR_SEARCH pre/post-filters, stored columns, and fraction_lists_to_search tuning — the performance/cost dial AEs need when productionizing indexes.
